name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A set of best-practice habits and checklists that make AI coding assistants actually follow good software engineering discipline instead of writing sloppy, bloated code.
buyer: An engineering manager who has rolled out AI coding assistants team-wide and needs guardrails so AI-written code doesn't become an unmaintainable mess.
business_use_cases: An engineering manager installs it org-wide as the default methodology for every AI coding session to cut code review time.
A consultancy that builds software for clients using AI agents adopts it to guarantee consistent code quality across projects.
A coding bootcamp teaches it as the 'how to actually work with AI coding agents' curriculum module.

money_ideas.idea: Sell an extended paid version with team dashboards and compliance reporting for engineering orgs rolling out AI coding at scale.
Offer paid workshops training engineering teams to adopt the methodology.

steal_this: Build a simple onboarding CLI this weekend that installs this skillset plus a few company-specific coding standards, and sell it as an 'AI coding onboarding kit' to small startups.
